journey.name: Jade Different Wallet
journey.description: Reseeds the paired Jade emulator and checks the message when the app reaches the device again. Requires a regtest debug build with the Jade emulator enabled (see the README) and the Jade from `./scripts/jade-emulator start` already paired. The emulator keeps its hardware id across a restart, as a wiped and restored Jade does.

actions.action: Run `JADE_MNEMONIC="abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about" ./scripts/jade-emulator start` in `bitkit-docker`
Launch the Bitkit app, tap Receive (testTag "Receive"), select the Jade tab and tap "Show Details" if the address is hidden behind it

Tap "Verify on Device" (testTag "HardwareVerifyAddress") and verify an error toast reads "This device holds a different wallet than the one you paired. Connect the paired wallet, or add this one as a new hardware wallet."
Run `./scripts/jade-emulator start` in `bitkit-docker` to restore the paired seed, tap "Verify on Device" again and verify no error appears
